name: Psi trial with covariates (ganzfeld-style)
summary: A blinded remote-viewing trial wrapped in the covariates most often reported in the psi literature, under conditions close to the ganzfeld noise-reduction method: belief and state first, a progressive relaxation, 30 minutes of eyes-covered mentation in steady pink noise, then a blind ranking of the pictures in the drawn set (chance 1 in the set size; 25 % with the 4-picture sets this series assumes). An optional blinded helmet arm during the mentation (the Remote viewing program, ring layout) turns it into a helmet x psi design. With 4-picture sets, about 315 trials (two-tailed; 250 one-tailed) are needed to tell a 32 % hit rate from 25 % with 80 % power, so this is a long-series protocol.
setting: At home, reclined. Eyes covered with halved ping-pong balls under a red light, or a red-tinted eye mask. Headphones. Keep only sets of 4 pictures in the pool for the whole series: a trial draws from every usable set, and the numbers here assume 1 in 4. If you use the helmet, fit it in the ring layout (see Placement); the program lasts exactly as long as the mentation and keeps running when you pause the guide, so don't pause during the mentation. There is no sender in this version; SAIC reported in 1994 that free-response trials do not need one.
cautions: Psi effects and their moderators are disputed (Hyman 2010; Rouder et al. 2013). Plan two-tailed tests, fix the number of trials in advance and keep every trial. Belief is recorded before feedback and kept apart from scoring.

sources.title: Storm L, Tressoldi PE, Di Risio L (2010) Meta-analysis of free-response studies, 1992-2008. Psychol Bull 136:471-485
Tressoldi PE, Storm L (2021) Anomalous perception in a Ganzfeld condition: a meta-analysis (Stage 2 registered report). F1000Research 10:234
Bem DJ, Honorton C (1994) Does psi exist? Replicable evidence for an anomalous process of information transfer. Psychol Bull 115:4-18
Mossbridge J, Radin D (2021) smartphone-based psi tests with TIPI and belief items. J Anomalous Exp Cogn 1:78-113
Hyman R (2010) Meta-analysis that conceals more than it reveals. Psychol Bull 136:486-490
Rouder JN, Morey RD, Province JM (2013) A Bayes factor meta-analysis of recent ESP experiments. Psychol Bull 139:241-247

steps.title: Belief and expectation
steps.instructions: Answer the questions about belief in ESP and your confidence for this trial.

steps.title: Your state now
steps.instructions: Rate how you are right now.

items.label: How much this trial matters to you
Alcohol, cannabis or other drugs in the last 12 hours (0 = no, 1 = yes)

steps.title: Blind target
steps.instructions: The helmet commits to a hidden target picture. The trial number is your tag.

steps.title: Helmet (optional)
steps.instructions: If you use the helmet, put it on now in the **ring layout** (see the Placement tab), not the temporal fit. It runs blinded during the mentation only, real or sham. Without the helmet, press Next.

steps.title: Progressive relaxation
steps.instructions: Lie back with your eyes closed. Starting with your feet, tense each muscle group for a few seconds, then let it go completely: feet, calves, thighs, belly, hands, arms, shoulders, neck, face. Then let your breathing settle by itself.

steps.title: Mentation
steps.instructions:
Cover your eyes. Let images, thoughts and feelings come and say them aloud as they come (record yourself with another app if you like). Don't judge or connect them; just report.

*Sound: steady pink noise at a comfortable level, as in ganzfeld studies (the level is logged).*

steps.title: Write it down
steps.instructions: Write down everything you noticed, as completely as you can.

input.prompt: Everything you noticed during the mentation

steps.title: Lock your response
steps.instructions: Lock your response before you see any picture.

steps.title: Rank the pictures
steps.instructions: Rank the pictures of the drawn set, best match with your mentation first.

steps.title: Confidence
steps.instructions: How confident are you in your first choice?

steps.title: Real or sham?
steps.instructions: If the helmet ran, guess whether its field was real or sham. If no helmet was used, skip this step.

steps.title: Reveal
steps.instructions: The helmet reveals the target and the app checks the commitment. A rank-1 hit has a chance of 1 in the number of pictures in the set (1 in 4 with the sets this series assumes).
